data.name: Winny
data.gender_notes: Winny is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic elements wīn meaning friend, love or dear and ni meaning kin or family. This name is derived from the Old English word wīnna, meaning to please or to win. In the Middle Ages, it was a pet form of names beginning with Wynne, Wyn, or Wynnebald. The name Winny carries the meaning “Friend, beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Winny usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the love and companionship of God.
data.etymology: Winny belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Winny total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
